item.title: 13k-Mile 2010 Ferrari 599 GTB Fiorano HGTE
item.description: This 2010 Ferrari 599 GTB Fiorano was sold new in New York and remained registered in the state until it was relocated to California in 2018. The current owner purchased it there in 2022 and has since added approximately 300 of the 13k indicated miles. The Nero DS1250-over-Nero car is powered by a 6.0-liter F140 V12 paired with a six-speed F1 automated transaxle. item.description: This 1965 Lincoln Continental convertible is finished in black over black leather and is powered by a 430ci V8 linked with a dual-range three-speed automatic transmission. item.title: The Kobus Interview, Revisited
item.description: We revisit our May 2023 interview with Kobus, BaT commenter and contributor extraordinaire. Topics include his formative years at Kyalami, racing his vintage Porsches and historic Formula V car, dangerous beauty of Schenley Park, the Goodwood Revival, Luftgekühlt, and Kobus' work for the 356 Registry.

item.title: One-Owner 1985 Mazda RX-7 GSL-SE 5-Speed at No Reserve
item.description: This 1985 Mazda RX-7 GSL-SE was delivered new to Lou Fusz Motor Company of St. Louis, Missouri, and was acquired new by the seller's parents. Finished in Royal Maroon Metallic over Wine velour upholstery, the car is powered by a 1.3-liter 13B rotary linked to a five-speed manual transmission and a limited-slip differential. item.description: This 1991 Land Rover Defender 110 is a left-hand-drive pickup powered by a retrofitted 3.5-liter V8 linked with a five-speed manual transmission and a dual-range transfer case. item.description: This 1971 Chevrolet K5 Blazer was modified as a drag truck in 2019. The vehicle features a custom boxed chassis, air suspension, power-assisted disc brakes, and 15” WELD Racing wheels along with a tubular roll cage, a louvered hood, fixed rear bodywork, and a dual exhaust system with side-exit outlets.
